jobs.description:
Job Description:

Summary:
At ITW, innovation starts with people who think like owners. We give our teams the freedom to experiment, the tools to succeed, and the responsibility to make an impact. As Senior Product Manager for our Celeste transportation chemicals product segment – you’ll be at the center of building and growing a brand trusted by commercial airlines and railways.

The ideal candidate brings experience working within technical, specification-driven industries (e.g., aerospace or similar), and is comfortable navigating long sales cycles, complex B2B environments, and cross-functional collaboration with engineering and technical teams.

What You'll Do:
- Effectively and regularly communicate with customers, sellers, technical service, research and development, and others to understand customer needs and product requirements (voice of the customer).
- Perform market research, competitive analysis and business data reporting (unit volumes, revenues, margin) to understand business trends and make informed decisions for current and future product direction.
- Define and communicate product strategy, roadmaps, and value propositions aligned with customer needs, business priorities, and brand objectives across key segments and channels in a highly fragmented market.
- Lead cross‑functional collaboration through all stages of product innovation and lifecycle management to deliver differentiated solutions that meet time‑to‑market, financial, regulatory, and performance expectations.
- Own portfolio, pricing, and assortment strategy, including omnichannel and eCommerce considerations, to drive profitable growth and optimize distribution, promotion, and merchandising effectiveness.
- Partner with Marketing Communications and Sales to develop and execute go‑to‑market plans, messaging, sales tools, training, and digital content (including web and PDPs) that clearly articulate product value.
- Drive data‑driven business and financial management, translating insights into actionable recommendations and leading initiatives that positively impact revenue, margin, and overall P&L performance.
- Collaborate broadly across Sales, Operations, R&D, Regulatory, Finance, IT, and other functions to ensure alignment, strong execution, and sustained business results.
- Coach, mentor, and develop Assistant and Associate Product Managers, supporting onboarding, capability building, and a high‑performance team culture.
- Apply and model ITW’s business model in all aspects of product management and decision‑making to improve organizational effectiveness and efficiency.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.
- 7–10 years of progressive brand and/or product marketing or product management experience in a manufacturing or other technically complex B2B or B2C environment, with demonstrated ability to understand, position, and commercialize products used in professional or industrial applications.
- Proven experience owning product strategy and driving business growth, including new & derivative product innovation, launches, portfolio management, and pricing strategy.
- Strong strategic, analytical, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to translate customer and market insights into clear, actionable product and business decisions; experienced in leveraging POS and shipment data tools such as Circana, NPD, or comparable platforms.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively across cross‑functional and highly matrixed teams.
- Demonstrated ability to deliver results through strong project management skills and informal leadership; prior people‑management or mentoring experience preferred.
- Experience with value‑based selling, application of the 80/20 business principle, and customer‑back innovation processes, including leading and training voice‑of‑the‑customer activities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and experience using ERP and CRM systems.

Other Competencies:
- Strong financial and analytical acumen, with the ability to drive product and portfolio performance toward bottom-line results.
- Entrepreneurial, opportunity‑oriented mindset with the ability to focus teams on the highest‑impact initiatives.
- Demonstrated strategic thinking and business problem‑solving capability.
- Highly collaborative, with a proven ability to influence and work effectively across diverse, cross‑functional teams.
- Ownership mentality with a track record of driving alignment, accountability, and positive change.
- Enterprise‑first perspective, balancing individual product priorities with broader organizational objectives.
- Strong communication and listening skills, with the ability to synthesize complex inputs and translate them into clear strategic direction.
- Adaptable and effective in dynamic environments, with strong prioritization and time‑management capability.

Work Environment:
- Able and willing to travel as necessary, domestically and/or internationally.
- Able to maintain a valid U.S. Passport, if traveling internationally.
- Able to work in an environment where there may be exposure to heat, cold, or controlled chemicals.
- Responsible for workspace and any assigned company property, equipment, or materials.

Why You'll Love Working Here:
At ITW, you’ll experience the best of both worlds: the autonomy of an entrepreneur with the resources of a Fortune 200 company. Our decentralized culture means your ideas matter, your ownership is real, and your impact is visible.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to lead our product management team in building and executing a global product roadmap that ensures sustainable differentiation and maintains a balanced portfolio of core and new products to drive growth in target markets. This role will manage and coach a team of product managers across all 5Ps while collaborating closely with cross-functional and project teams throughout product development and lifecycle processes. The position also supports Instron leadership on business segment strategies and ensures effective collaboration with global sales to drive regional activities and marketing plans focused on maintaining Instron’s high level of customer satisfaction and market differentiation.

Product & Innovation Strategy

- Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new product, application, service, and market opportunities.

- Lead customer-back innovation initiatives that transform customer insights into validated growth opportunities and compelling business cases.

- Champion opportunity assessment and investment decisions through Instron's innovation and development processes.

- Partner with Segment Management and Engineering teams to ensure product roadmaps align with customer needs, market trends, and segment growth objectives.

- Guide portfolio decisions that balance growth, profitability, customer value, and strategic differentiation.

- Own products commercial performance including revenue, cost and margin performance, as well as quality and customer satisfaction. Develop and implement pricing strategies for product offerings, including promotional pricing. Manage pricing to achieve business objectives throughout the product lifecycle.

Team Leadership

- Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans for team members.

- Foster a culture of accountability, customer focus, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Develop organizational capabilities in market intelligence, customer insight generation, portfolio management, and strategic planning.

- Promote knowledge sharing and cross-functional collaboration throughout the organization.

- Exceptional leadership, communication, influence, and interpersonal skills.

- Strong strategic thinking, business planning, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.

- Demonstrated ability to translate market insights into successful growth strategies and business results.

- Strong understanding of industrial manufacturing, engineering applications, materials testing, capital equipment, or related technical industries.

- Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing organizational decisions.

- Experience developing business cases, growth strategies, market assessments, and portfolio strategies.

- Strong commercial acumen, including understanding of revenue growth, profitability, pricing, market share, and return-on-investment principles.

- Experience operating within a global business environment.

- Passion for technology, innovation, and customer success.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Business, Marketing, or a related technical discipline.

- Advanced business or technical degree preferred.

- Typically 6+ years of experience across strategic marketing, product management, business leadership, applications engineering, commercial leadership, or related functions.

- Experience with capital equipment, industrial technology solutions, or materials testing strongly preferred.

- Experience engaging directly with customers, industry organizations, and standards bodies is highly desirable.

Working Conditions
- Daily interaction with a dynamic, collaborative, and highly engaged global team.

- Hybrid office environment with flexible work arrangements.

- Travel is expected and will include customer visits, industry conferences, trade events, and global business meetings.

- Approximately 25-30% travel, including occasional international travel.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of a business that has defined materials testing excellence for decades. You'll have the opportunity to influence product direction, work with cross-functional teams, and contribute to the continued success of some of the most trusted brands in the welding industry.

Job Description:

IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP WILL NOT BE PROVIDED FOR THIS POSITION

COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Illinois Tool Works Inc. (NYSE: ITW) is a Fortune 200 global multi-industry manufacturing leader with revenue of $16 billion in 2025. The company’s seven industry-leading segments leverage the unique ITW Business Model to drive solid growth with best-in-class margins and returns in markets where highly innovative, customer-focused solutions are required. ITW’s approximately 45,000 dedicated colleagues around the world thrive in the company’s decentralized and entrepreneurial culture.

From state-of-the-art dishwashers, ovens and refrigerators in restaurants and hotels, to automobile components inside vehicles all over the world ... the products we manufacture and the solutions we design are all around us. The buildings where we live and work are built with ITW construction and welding products, and our ITW test & measurement solutions help to ensure the quality and safety of millions of products.

With gross revenues near $250 million, Traulsen is proud to be known as the premier name in refrigeration for the foodservice market since its founding in 1938. We provide professional expertise and high-quality equipment for savvy food service customers. Every Traulsen product is engineered, fabricated, assembled, and tested at our facilities in Fort Worth, Texas.

TOTAL REWARDS PACKAGE

Our total rewards package is broad and offers comprehensive support from health and wellness to retirement and financial stability. For more details see  https://www.itw.com/careers/benefits-compensation/

POSITION SUMMARY

The product manager is responsible for leading market-driven innovation and growth by translating customer insights and market trends into product opportunities, developing and executing product and vertical marketing strategies, and guiding go-to-market initiatives. The role supports the innovation pipeline, contributes to stage-gate product development, and provides strategic market analysis to identify growth opportunities, expand into new markets, and drive revenue, share, and profitability for the division.

Within the company, this role works closely with our one-FEG sales team to drive organic growth. This position also works with Traulsen colleagues from engineering, operations, finance, quality, and customer service. Outside the company, the position collaborates closely with customers, independent sales representatives, end-users, dealers, and specifiers / consultants.

This position reports to the Director of Marketing, North America Refrigeration.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Innovation Process:
- Division expert on market dynamics, industry trends, competitors and customers’ current and future needs.

- Capture and translate Voice of Customer (VOC) and market trends into incremental, differentiated product commercialization opportunities. Leverage understanding to build customer confidence in Traulsen’s ability to be the partner of choice.

- Identify serial innovation opportunities that successfully address market needs and generate sustainable and profitable growth that aligns with the division’s strategic intent.

- Drive innovation pipeline with division leadership pulling from a screened opportunity list.

- Key team member in the innovation stage gate process working with engineering and core project team.  Actively participate and deliver marketing requirements for each stage gate.

Strategy Development and Execution:
- Obtain and leverage market insights to develop and effectively execute thorough vertical marketing strategies aligned with the division growth objectives.

- Lead the development of product line strategies aligned with market segment strategies and clearly identify, validate, and articulate value propositions to each market sub-segment.

- Develop business cases for new target markets, product innovations, services or customers.

- Develop and execute go-to-market strategy around product portfolio, with division commercial leadership.

- Drive the deploy stage of product launch to market, including participating in product launches.

Market Segment Leader:
- Provide strategic leadership with the ability to size markets and determine attractiveness of adjacent markets.

- Provide strategic insights, analysis, directional input and drives the execution of key growth and sales initiatives.

- Drive and execute segmentation and market research (primary and secondary) as needed to identify growth opportunities and articulate how Traulsen can capitalize on them.

- Report on customer and market segment results for assigned portfolio, including revenue, growth rates, share gain, and profitability metrics and can explain key drivers of change.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Engineering, or Business required

- MBA preferred

Experience/Skills:
- 5+ years of progressive business experience, including 2+ years of strategic marketing, sales development, pricing and product management experience required.

- 2+ years of big three consulting experience preferred.

- Excellent strategic thinker and a proven record of delivering business growth, with an aggressive growth mindset.

- Highly effective cross-functional leader and influencer, with excellent collaboration, communication and presentation skills.

- Strong ability to navigate the complexity of Traulsen’s market reach, bring focus and simplify strategically.

- Well-versed in deploying and leveraging various marketing research methods and translating end user requirements into successful innovative solutions in a B2B environment.

- Excellent analytical skills, pricing strategy experience and financial acumen. Experience with P&L management a plus.

Job Description:

As Product Manager for the Dynamic Systems Test and Measurement, based at our High Wycombe site, you will be at the forefront of driving innovation, growth, and market leadership.
This role combines strategic vision with hands-on product leadership, owning the full product lifecycle from concept and development through commercialization and ongoing optimization. By leveraging data-driven insights and collaborating closely with engineering, sales, and marketing teams, you will identify emerging customer needs, uncover new growth opportunities, and work with our business leaders to shape the product roadmap to deliver industry-leading solutions. Success in this role will be measured by your ability to create growth opportunities which accelerate innovation, enhance customer satisfaction, and generate tangible business outcomes that strengthen the company's competitive position across a global market.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities
- Undertake the total lifecycle management of dynamic systems products to support the setting and delivery of the long-term product vision and strategy.
- Develop a deep and practical understanding of dynamic systems products and services to become the expert for the product line, acting as an internal and external advocate for Instron solutions.
- Analyse business drivers, customer needs, markets, technology and competition to identify gaps and growth opportunities that support informed business decisions and objectives.
- Create robust 5P go-to-market plans that support the successful launch of new products/services and maximize internal and external customer satisfaction.
- Own product value delivery and measurement, baseline product performance and tracking outcome metrics (customer, commercial and operational) to demonstrate and realise value.
- Support product marketing team to deliver impactful promotional campaigns, content and collateral that enhance the customer experience, increase product/brand awareness and support lead generation.
- Manage relevant product financials (budget, costs, value, etc.) to ensure the accurate price positioning of products to maximise sales performance across a range of different commercial arenas.
- Maintain and apply a working knowledge of the business Enterprise strategy, using it to guide decision making processes to promote and lead culture of sustainable innovation and development.

Qualifications, Experiences & Competencies
- Bachelor’s degree in science or engineering (or equivalent qualification/marketing-related discipline).
- Experience gained in a B2B, Engineering or Manufacturing environment is preferred but not essential.
- Demonstrable product management experience (3~5 Years) in a similar or relevant industry (Mechanical and material testing product and market knowledge is preferred).
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and pro-actively deliver high-quality outcomes.
- An excellent team player that can work in an office-based environment who also possesses the ability to work independently and has experienced customer-facing sales scenarios.
- Desire to maintain awareness of emerging technologies in new media, constantly striving to gain further knowledge and willing to learn new things related to the role.
- Full UK driver’s license.

Working Conditions
- Normal office and factory environment with limited physical discomfort due to the manufacturing environment (temperature, noise, dust, etc).
- Intermittent European and International travel expected throughout the year.
- Some lifting and handling may be required in the facilitation of customer product demonstrations and events.
